title: Customer Churn Prediction
summary: Built a gradient-boosted model to flag subscribers likely to cancel 30 days out, replacing a rule-based heuristic the retention team had been using.
metric: Lifted recall on at-risk customers from 41% to 76%, at a precision retention could act on.

title: Store-Level Demand Forecasting
summary: Forecasted weekly SKU-level demand across 120 stores using a hierarchical time-series approach, feeding directly into the inventory ordering system.
metric: Cut forecast error (MAPE) from 22% to 13%, reducing stockouts in the pilot region.

title: NLP Resume Screener
summary: Fine-tuned a transformer classifier to rank incoming applications against a role's requirements, with an explanation of which lines drove the score.
metric: Cut recruiter first-pass screening time by roughly 60% in a two-week trial.
